# KM-187 — Design: one top-right Sign In button; delete the separate sign-in page

**Lane:** design · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** claude-opus · **Depends on:** KM-180 · **Serializes with:** KM-134 (both change signed-out handling in `composition/human/mount.tsx`); KM-180 (`mount.tsx` shell, already a dependency)
**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md) · **Design spec:** `docs/design/khala-chat/RECREATION-SPEC.md` §19 (with §2.1 fonts and §13.2 state card)
**Exclusive write surfaces:**
- **Landing:** `apps/web/src/landing/{index.html,landing.css,main.ts,landing.test.ts,landing.browser.spec.ts,showcase.browser.spec.ts,landing.visual.spec.ts,landing.visual.spec.ts-snapshots/**}`.
- **App:** `apps/web/src/composition/human/mount.tsx` (the `SignInPanel` region and the `renderSignedOut` prop only) and `mount.test.tsx` (signed-out cases).

## Outcome

- **Landing page** (`/`):
  - The hero's "Open Khala app" button is gone.
  - The top-right controls are **Docs · theme toggle · Sign in**. Sign in is a pill styled as the design's top-right `.tool-btn` in its accent variant.
  - Clicking Sign in goes straight to Google sign-in (`/api/human/auth/login?return_to=%2Fconversations`) and returns to the signed-in conversations view.
  - After a cancelled or failed sign-in, the landing page shows a one-line status under the topbar.
- **App:** the separate sign-in page no longer exists. Any signed-out app route, including `/join/…` and `/agent/confirm…`, immediately redirects to sign-in and returns to the same path. The only intermediate UI is a spinner card, "Signing in…".

## Context and evidence

- Operator directive (2026-10-02): "replace the 'Open Khala App' button and the full separate sign-in page with a single Sign In button at top right; delete the separate sign-in page; the button redirects straight to Google sign-in and then to the signed-in view."
- Design top-right control styling: `.tool-btn` (`docs/design/khala-chat/source/Aiur Dashboard.html:226-235`) and its accent variant `.tool-btn.analytics` (`:236-237`).
- Current code at `5db209cc`:
  - Landing CTA: `apps/web/src/landing/index.html:60`; `.app-cta` at `landing/landing.css:528-530`.
  - Top-right controls: `landing/index.html:29-35`; `.topbar` at `landing/landing.css:143-152`.
  - Tests pinning the CTA: `landing/landing.test.ts:51`, `landing/landing.browser.spec.ts:119,132-133,148-149,230`, `landing/showcase.browser.spec.ts:36`.
  - Sign-in page: `SignInPanel` at `apps/web/src/composition/human/mount.tsx:75-102`, wired at `:343`.
  - `beginSignIn` at `composition/human/browser-api.ts:231-236`; `LOGIN_PATH = '/api/human/auth/login'` at `:45`.
  - Server: login 302 at `apps/control/src/composition/human/handlers.ts:231-241`; on callback denial or error it 303s to `/?sign_in=cancelled` or `/?sign_in=error` (`:254`), which is the landing page.
- KM-134 already adds an auto-redirect for `/agent/confirm`, except with `?sign_in=cancelled` (`docs/build/m1/tickets/KM-134.md` test 13). This ticket makes that the behaviour for every route, so KM-134's special case is folded in.

## Scope

1. **Landing Sign in.** Add `<a class="button signin" href="/api/human/auth/login?return_to=%2Fconversations">Sign in</a>` as the last child of `header.topbar` (`index.html:29-35`). CSS from spec §19.2, item 1, verbatim:
   - `font-family: "JetBrains Mono", var(--font-mono), monospace` (the design's UI mono font, with the self-hosted copy as fallback)
   - `min-height: 42px; box-sizing: border-box`, to match the 42px theme toggle
   - On `:root`, define `--accent-line`, `--accent-ink` and `--accent-soft` with the spec §2.2 values, in dark by default and light under `:root[data-theme='light']`
   - **No Bungee** on it
2. **Delete the CTA.** Remove `index.html:60` and `.app-cta` (`landing.css:528-530`). Update the five tests to the Sign in link: name `Sign in`, the href above, and the light and dark colours `--accent-ink` on the border/pill.
3. **Outcome notice.** In `landing/main.ts`, read `new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('sign_in')`. For `cancelled` or `error`, insert after the topbar `<p class="signin-status" role="status">Sign-in was cancelled.</p>` or `<p class="signin-status" role="status">Sign-in could not be completed.</p>`, styled `.signin-status { text-align: right; padding: .25rem clamp(0.9rem, 3vw, 1.25rem) 0; font-size: .76rem; color: var(--muted); }`. Then remove the parameter with `history.replaceState`. Keep it CSP-safe: module script only, no inline script.
4. **Delete `SignInPanel`** (`mount.tsx:75-102`). Add `SignInRedirect({ identity, path, navigateExternal })`:
   - On mount, call `identity.beginSignIn(path)` **once** (guard against StrictMode double-invoke with a ref). On `ok`, call `navigateExternal(result.value.url)`.
   - While pending, render `<section class="kh-state" aria-label="Signing in"><div class="kh-state-c"><span class="kh-spin" aria-hidden="true"></span><b>Signing in…</b></div></section>`.
   - On failure, render `<div class="kh-state-c"><b>Sign-in is unavailable right now.</b><button type="button" class="kh-btn">Try again</button></div>`, where **Try again** retries `beginSignIn`.
   - Wire it at `renderSignedOut` (`mount.tsx:343`). Delete the `isJoin` and `AgentJoinGuidance` usage from the signed-out path, and remove the `AgentJoinGuidance` import if it is now unused.
5. Do **not** special-case `?sign_in=cancelled` in the app. The server returns the user to `/` in that case, never to an app path.
6. **`/new`** keeps working for signed-in users. Nothing in the landing page links to it any more.

## Contract and invariants

- Login URL: `/api/human/auth/login?return_to=<same-origin path>`. The server requires exactly one `return_to` (`handlers.ts:235-236`). The landing uses `%2Fconversations`.
- `beginSignIn` rejects non-same-origin paths (`browser-api.ts:232`). Pass the current app path unchanged.
- Fonts: the landing button uses the design UI mono stack; nothing new uses Bungee.

## Implementation pointers (refreshable @ 5db209cc)

### Files

**Modify:** the files listed in **Exclusive write surfaces**.

**Delete:** the `SignInPanel` function and its `KhalaPageFrame` title "Sign in to Khala".

### Worked example

1. A signed-out user opens `/channels/!r1%3Akhala.local`.
2. `HumanScreen` reaches `signed_out` and calls `renderSignedOut('/channels/!r1%3Akhala.local')`.
3. `SignInRedirect` calls `beginSignIn('/channels/!r1%3Akhala.local')`, which returns `https://khala.local/api/human/auth/login?return_to=%2Fchannels%2F!r1%253Akhala.local`.
4. `navigateExternal(url)` sends the user to Google. Afterwards the callback 303s to `return_to` and the channel opens signed in.
5. If the user cancels at Google instead, the server sends them to `/?sign_in=cancelled`, and the landing page shows "Sign-in was cancelled." next to the Sign in button.

### Steps

1. Landing: add the button and its CSS, delete the CTA, add the notice. Update the landing tests.
2. App: replace `SignInPanel` with `SignInRedirect` and update `mount.test.tsx`.
3. Rebaseline the landing visuals in the pinned image: `docker run --rm -v "$PWD:$PWD" -w "$PWD" mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble sh -c 'corepack pnpm --filter @khala/web test:visual -- --update-snapshots'`.

## Test scenarios

- `landing/landing.test.ts`:
  1. The HTML contains `<a class="button signin" href="/api/human/auth/login?return_to=%2Fconversations">Sign in</a>` inside `.topbar`.
  2. It does not contain `Open Khala app` or `app-cta`.
- `landing/landing.browser.spec.ts`:
  1. The `Sign in` link is the last control in `.topbar`.
  2. Its `href` is as above.
  3. Its computed `border-radius` is `999px`, `font-size` is `12.16px` (.76rem) and `font-family` starts with `"JetBrains Mono"`. Its height equals the theme toggle's.
  4. Dark and light colours: text `--accent-ink`, and on hover the background is `--accent-soft`.
  5. `/?sign_in=cancelled` shows the status line, and the URL loses the parameter.
  6. No inline script is added (the CSP test stays green).
- `landing/showcase.browser.spec.ts:36`: assert the Sign in link in place of the CTA.
- `composition/human/mount.test.tsx`:
  1. Signed out on `/conversations` → `beginSignIn('/conversations')` is called once, and `navigateExternal` is called with its URL.
  2. No heading "Sign in to Khala" and no button "Sign in" is rendered.
  3. `beginSignIn` fails → "Sign-in is unavailable right now." plus **Try again**, which re-calls it.
  4. Signed out on `/join/<ref>` → it redirects with that path, and the join guidance is not rendered.
  5. Signed out on `/agent/confirm?joinId=j1` → it redirects with `'/agent/confirm?joinId=j1'`. This subsumes KM-134 test 13.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @khala/web test`
- `pnpm --filter @khala/web test:browser`
- `pnpm typecheck`
- The visual rebaseline in the pinned image.

**Done when:**
- On the local stack, clicking **Sign in** on `/` lands, after Google, on `/conversations` signed in.
- A signed-out deep link redirects without ever showing a sign-in page.

## Risks and stop conditions

- If KM-134 lands its own signed-out branch in `mount.tsx`, merge into the single `SignInRedirect` and keep KM-134's tests green.
- If the operator wants an "Open Khala" label for already-signed-in visitors, stop and ask. The landing page cannot read the session without a new endpoint, and adding one is out of scope.

## Complexity rationale

2: a small landing change plus deleting one composition component, with test updates.
